title: 10 Best Rooftop Bars in Bucharest — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best rooftop bars in Bucharest — curated from Reddit reviews and local tips. NOR Sky, Linea, BARTINI, 18Lounge, Aria TNB & more. Panoramic views, craft cocktails, and honest verdicts.

places.name: Nor Sky Casual Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: NOR is the highest restaurant in Bucharest and the view is absolutely breathtaking. Go for sunset if you can — the whole city lights up below you.

places.verdict: The verdict: At 136 meters above Bucharest on the 36th floor of Sky Tower, NOR is the undisputed king of Bucharest rooftop dining. The panoramic view stretches across the entire city — you can see the Palace of Parliament, the Arch of Triumph, and the Carpathian foothills on clear days. The menu blends global cuisines with local Romanian touches, and the cocktail program features signature drinks made with Romanian spirits and botanicals. Reservations are essential, especially for sunset tables on the terrace.

places.name: Linea | Closer To The Moon
places.address: Strada Lipscani 17, Fifth Floor, Old Town

redditQuotes.text: Linea stands out as one of Bucharest's top rooftop bars, drawing crowds for its fancy cocktails and, most notably, its stunning views of the Old Town. Catching the sunset here ensures a perfect evening.

places.verdict: The verdict: Perched atop the historic Victoria department store on Strada Lipscani, Linea is Bucharest's most photographed rooftop. The Old Town panorama — church spires, Belle Époque rooftops, and the distant Palace of Parliament — is genuinely stunning. The Mediterranean-inspired food menu is solid, but people come here for the cocktails, the vibe, and the view. In winter, the heated rooftop igloos are one of Bucharest's most unique experiences. Live music sessions add to the energy on weekends. Book ahead — this is the city's most in-demand rooftop.

places.name: BARTINI Rooftop
places.address: Strada Constantin Mille 18, T Floor, Old Town

redditQuotes.text: Perched above the lively streets of Old Town Bucharest, the rooftop offers breathtaking views of the city, with the stunning CEC Palace looking magnificent.

places.verdict: The verdict: The newest star in Bucharest's rooftop scene, BARTINI has shot to a 4.8-star rating on both Google and TripAdvisor. The terrace offers one of the most iconic views in the city — the illuminated CEC Palace directly in front of you, with the Old Town spreading behind it. The cocktail menu is creative and well-executed, the food is surprisingly good for a rooftop bar, and the staff is consistently praised. Access is via stairs from the M floor — look for the signage. This is the rooftop Bucharest locals are currently talking about.

places.name: 18Lounge by Embassy
places.address: City Gate South Tower, Piața Presei Libere 3-5, 18th Floor

redditQuotes.text: What sets this place apart? It's the perfect blend of fine dining, music, and design, all enhanced by a fantastic city view. Come evening, the restaurant transforms into a romantic spot.

places.verdict: The verdict: On the 18th floor of City Gate South Tower, 18Lounge offers a magical view over Herăstrău Park (now King Mihai I Park) and the northern Bucharest skyline. It seats 180 inside and 60 on the terrace, and the architecture features large panoramic windows and a retractable roof. The seasonal à la carte menu features international flavors while the cocktail bar serves signature creations made with local and fresh products. The vegan menu is notably good — unusual for a high-end rooftop. This is the go-to for special occasions and romantic evenings in northern Bucharest.

places.name: Amethyst Sky Bar & Rooftop
places.address: Union Plaza Hotel, Bulevardul Unirii 47C, 12th Floor
places.verdict: The verdict: Perched on the 12th floor of Union Plaza Hotel on Bulevardul Unirii, Amethyst offers one of Bucharest's most dramatic vantage points — the massive Palace of Parliament looms across the boulevard, beautifully illuminated at night. The contemporary, uber-chic interior has panoramic windows, while the outdoor terrace catches the evening breeze. The cocktail menu leans into high-end signatures with artistic presentations, and the wine selection focuses on Romanian producers. The modern international food menu adds artistic touches to familiar dishes. Best at night when the Parliament lights up.

places.name: Aria TNB

redditQuotes.text: Situated atop the National Theatre in the bustling heart of the city, Aria TNB provides a serene escape. The elegant terrace offers an ideal setting for special moments under the open sky.

places.verdict: The verdict: Found on top of the National Theatre (Teatrul Național) at Piața Universității, Aria TNB is a modern urban oasis above the busiest intersection in central Bucharest. The spacious terrace provides panoramic views of the capital while the impressive interior lounge has floor-to-ceiling windows. The cocktail menu features signatures, fresh Prosecco drinks, fine spirits, and craft brews. Live music on select evenings elevates the atmosphere. It's the most accessible of Bucharest's top rooftops — right in the center — and the perfect pre- or post-theatre stop. The vibe is elegant but not stuffy.

places.name: NOMAD SkyBar

redditQuotes.text: In the Old Town, you can still enjoy a view of Bucharest from above, away from the bustling streets. It's a great place if you're looking for a hip spot in the capital.

places.verdict: The verdict: NOMAD is three venues in one — a restaurant, a bar, and a weekend club — all perched above the crowded streets of Old Town Bucharest. The design is colorful, urban, and extravagant, with a retractable roof covering the main space, a narrow open-air terrace with bar stools overlooking the Old Town rooftops, and a secret garden for quieter moments. The menu spans global and local dishes with creative cocktails and an impressive wine selection. On weekends, the energy turns up with DJs spinning until the early morning. It's the most versatile rooftop in Bucharest — dinner at 8pm, cocktails at 10pm, dancing at midnight.

places.name: Cișmigiu — Bistro La Etaj
places.verdict: The verdict: The rooftop bistro atop the historic Hotel Cișmigiu captures the "Little Paris" essence of Bucharest better than anywhere else. The chic-casual design pairs an inviting atmosphere with views of the Palace of Parliament and the Cișmigiu Garden — Bucharest's oldest park. The food menu features original recipes with ingredients that "have stories to tell," and the cocktail list is genuinely creative. The ambiance is more intimate and romantic than the large-scale rooftops — this is where you go for a date or a quiet evening with friends, not a party. The 4.7 rating from 2,000+ reviews speaks volumes.

places.name: DESCHIS Gastrobar
places.verdict: The verdict: "Deschis" means "open" in Romanian, and this venue lives up to its name. Situated atop the Cotton Factory along the Dâmbovița River, DESCHIS is part rooftop bar, part cultural center — hosting film screenings, educational workshops, creative debates, and art events alongside its food and drink service. The spacious open-air terrace is at its best in summer, while an indoor lounge keeps things going year-round. The vibe is relaxed, friendly, and creative — the antithesis of a velvet-rope rooftop. Food and drinks are the most affordable on this list, making it perfect for a long afternoon session.

places.name: KLANdestin
places.verdict: The verdict: A bit outside the city center in the Titan neighborhood, KLANdestin rewards the journey with a panoramic view over IOR Park — one of Bucharest's largest green spaces. It's a gastropub-meets-lounge-meets-observation deck where locals come for wine, conversation, and a view that feels completely different from the Old Town rooftops. The wine list is particularly strong, the food is honest Romanian-international gastropub fare, and the atmosphere is convivial without trying too hard. If you're staying in eastern Bucharest or want to see the city from a local perspective beyond the tourist center, this is the one.
